note: NOT an engine run — a trial of the CANDIDATE ASTC encoder (`astc-encoder.js` 1.0.0, wasm bindings of ARM astc-encoder), taken because plan 097 chain 2 turned from Basis/KTX2 to a direct ASTC encode (user decision 2026-08-06) and that turn is only honest with an encode measured rather than assumed. Ran by Claude in the session container (x64 Linux, node 22, ONE thread) on a synthetic 128x128 RGBA8 image: two colour ramps plus a hard-edged circle with binary alpha, chosen because a hard alpha edge is what SA's cutout foliage is made of and what a block codec is worst at. Comparable to nothing else in this folder: no GPU, no pak, no device. What it establishes is the format's PRICE (bytes/texel) and that quality and encode time are measurable at all — the encoder ships `computeErrorMetrics`, so chain 2's PSNR floor can be evaluated over the real texture set without writing a metric of our own.
